newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: HARTIES DEATH TOLL 15, SHAFT STILL CLOSED.
newsitem.headline: HARTIES DEATH TOLL 15, SHAFT STILL CLOSED.

text.p: South African mining house Avgold Ltd said on Wednesday that the confirmed death toll following a tremor at its Hartebeestfontein gold mine earlier this week was now 15.
A further three miners remain missing and the chances of them being alive are considered slight, a spokesman said.

A large seismic event at the mine's No 4 A shaft area at a depth below surface of about 2,170 metres resulted in severe damage to underground excavations. The shaft, which accounts for around 20 percent of production at the mine, remains closed.
Hartebeestfontein produced 5.3 tonnes of gold in the first quarter of this year.
